description: Travel risk and aviation data: country risk, government advisories, disaster and conflict alerts, airports, flights, airlines and in-flight Wi-Fi.
instructions:
Travel Risk API: travel risk and aviation data for travel managers, duty-of-care teams, booking tools and agents.
Risk: country risk scores (0-5), government travel advisory levels (1-4) from several governments, active natural-disaster
and weather alerts, recent armed-conflict events. Aviation: airport delay status, security and immigration waits, weather,
airline profiles and safety facts, aircraft, flight status, in-flight Wi-Fi and Starlink, land-border waits, IP geolocation.
Countries are ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 codes (FRA, USA). Airports IATA (JFK) or ICAO (KJFK). Airlines IATA (UA). Flights like UA1.
Each tool returns {"data", "fetched_at"}. An error 'not_found' means no data for a valid request. Docs: https://travelriskapi.com/docs

tools.name: country_risk
tools.description: Travel risk for a country: composite risk score (0-5), government advisory level (1-4), number of active alerts by severity and how the score is built. Args: country = ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code (FRA, USA, JPN).

tools.name: country_profile
tools.description: Country profile: name, region, current advisory level with summary, and active alerts. Args: country = ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code.

tools.name: travel_advisories
tools.description: Official travel advisories for a country from several governments (for example the US, UK, Canada and Australia), each normalised to a 1-4 level with its own summary and link. Args: country = ISO alpha-3 code; min_level = optional 1-4 filter.

tools.name: active_alerts
tools.description: Active natural-disaster and severe-weather alerts (earthquakes, storms, floods, wildfires and more). Args (all optional): country = ISO alpha-3 code; severity = Low | Medium | High | Critical; days = only alerts from the last N days; limit = 1-100 (default 20).

tools.name: conflict_events
tools.description: Recent armed-conflict and political-violence events with location, severity and a news link. Args (all optional): country = ISO alpha-3 code; days = look-back window (default 7); limit = 1-100 (default 20).

tools.name: assess_trip
tools.description: Check a whole itinerary in one call. For each segment: destination country risk score and advisory levels, active alerts within 300 km of the arrival airport (or in the country for a stay) and live status for flights departing within 48 hours; `flags` lists what needs attention, most severe first. Args: segments = list of {type: 'flight'|'stay', flight?: 'UA1', from_airport?: 'SFO', to_airport?: 'NRT', country?: 'JPN', city?, start?: ISO datetime, end?: ISO datetime}; trip_id optional.

tools.name: airport_conditions
tools.description: One-call picture of an airport: delay programs and ground stops, security checkpoint waits, immigration waits, current weather and forecast, and recent traffic. Coverage of waits and delay programs is strongest for the US; weather is worldwide. Args: airport = IATA (JFK) or ICAO (KJFK) code.

tools.name: airport_security_wait
tools.description: Security checkpoint wait times by checkpoint for an airport, with how each figure was measured and when. Args: airport = IATA or ICAO code.

tools.name: border_wait
tools.description: Land border crossing wait times (US borders with Canada and Mexico) by lane. Args: port = port name (San Ysidro) or port number.

tools.name: airline_profile
tools.description: Airline profile: identity, fleet, IOSA safety-audit registration, accident history and safety facts, links. Args: airline = IATA (UA) or ICAO (UAL) code.

tools.name: aircraft
tools.description: Aircraft by registration: type, manufacturer, operator, age where known, and in-flight Wi-Fi. Args: registration = tail number such as N12216 or F-GSQA.

tools.name: flight_status
tools.description: Live status of a flight: departure and arrival airports, scheduled, estimated and actual times, delays, gate and terminal where available. Args: flight = IATA flight number such as UA1.

tools.name: flight_wifi
tools.description: Expected in-flight Wi-Fi for a flight: probability of Starlink or another system, or none, based on the aircraft usually flying it. Args: flight = IATA flight number (UA1); date = optional YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: airline_wifi
tools.description: In-flight Wi-Fi of an airline by aircraft type: system, speed class, whether it is free, and the share of the fleet with Starlink. Args: airline = IATA or ICAO code.

tools.name: ip_geolocation
tools.description: Approximate location of a public IP address: country, region, city and coordinates. Args: ip = IPv4 or IPv6.
